Desktop v5.0.65

  • Fast JDK 21 installation. Download now uses 4 parallel Range-request chunks with resume support (partial downloads continue where they left off), and the fastest mirror is auto-selected by a latency benchmark at startup. Extraction switched from slow PowerShell Expand-Archive to parallel Kotlin ZipFile extraction (~4x faster). The progress bar now shows exact file size (MB), download speed (MB/s), ETA, chunk index, and extracted-file count across every phase (connecting/downloading/validating/extracting/verifying).
  • Marketplace search defaults to server add-ons. Default search now returns plugins, mods, and datapacks together (OR project_type facet), so searching e.g. terralith finds the datapack instead of only plugins/mods. Added Datapack as an explicit loader filter option.
  • Player Management live players. Online tab now shows live players from console join/leave parsing instead of stale usercache.json. Each player row shows a deterministic Minecraft head icon and action buttons: Kick (/kick), Ban (/ban), OP (/op), De-OP (/deop). Player dedup on join events matches Android behavior.
  • Marketplace datapack routing fixed. Datapacks now install to world/datapacks/ (Minecraft's actual datapack directory) instead of plugins/. Project type checked first: datapack → world/datapacks, resourcepack → resourcepacks, mod with fabric/forge/neoforge/quilt → mods, plugin or paper/spigot/purpur/folia loaders → plugins. Projects with project_type=mod + loaders=[datapack] now correctly route to world/datapacks. Client-side types (shader, resourcepack, modpack) show "Client-side only" and disable the Install button.
  • Navigation fixes. ServerDetailScreen tab sub-screens (Files/Performance/Logs/RCON) pass onBack = { selectedTab = 0 } to return to Properties. ServerFilesScreen smart back button goes up a folder first. PlayerManagementScreen header back button. New RecentActivityScreen with Screen.Activity route; Dashboard "View All" navigates to it.
  • Marketplace install button fixed. Tab content was fillMaxSize() inside a fixed Column, pushing BottomInstallBar off-screen. Wrapped tab content in Box(Modifier.weight(1f)) so the "Install to Server" button is always visible.
  • Logback timing fix verified. Logs land in D:\portalhost\portalhost.log; stale %TEMP%\PortalHost directory no longer recreated.
  • Branding overhaul — green primary + portal violet/cyan accents. Applied AppTheme (green #2E7D32/#81C784, portal violet #7C4DFF/#4A148C, cyan #0097A7/#40C4FF) to desktop. Window titlebar uses MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface (#1E1E1E dark) with square logo + "Portal Host" text.
  • New logo assets. Square portalhost_logo.png (1024×1024 ARGB) for taskbar/alt-tab; horizontal portalhost_wordmark.png (1536×1024) for About screen; portalhost2.ico (16/32/48/64/128 BMP) for installers.
  • Installers rebuilt. PortalHost-5.0.65.msi and PortalHost-5.0.65.exe include all fixes and new branding.

Desktop v5.0.64

  • Fixed: Duplicate server folders upon creation. Creating a server no longer creates both a UUID-based folder and a name-based folder. The UI screens were using File(serversDir, serverId) (UUID path) while ServerManager.getServerDir() resolves to name-based paths. All 20+ occurrences across CreateServerScreen, ServerDetailScreen, DashboardScreen, ServersScreen, ServerFilesScreen, and LogViewerScreen now use the correct name-based directory.
  • Fixed: Marketplace/Add-on browser HTTP 404 with filter changes. httpGet() was reading conn.inputStream before checking the response code, causing an IOException (with the full URL including limit=20) for non-2xx responses instead of reading the error stream. Response code is now checked first, producing clean error messages.
  • Fixed: Legacy UUID folders now cleaned up. Migration from UUID folders to name-based folders now properly deletes source files after copying and removes the UUID folder recursively.
  • Fixed: Marketplace screen used hardcoded ~/.portalhost/servers path. Now uses fileSystem.getServersDirBlocking() to respect the custom data directory setting.
  • Fixed: JVM launch failure (FAILED TO LAUNCH JVM). Found that the stale Java Preferences dataDirectory value (set to PortalHost.exe path) caused the database initialization to fail, crashing the app before launch. The jpackage launcher misleadingly reported "Failed to launch JVM". The actual JVM launched fine — the crash was from the database trying to open at the EXE file path. Cleared stale preference; app now uses default ~/.portalhost/ data directory.

Android v5.0.30 — Initial Android Release

  • Full Minecraft Java Edition server manager for Android 7.0+ (API 24)
  • Background server hosting via foreground service with persistent notification showing CPU/RAM/TPS
  • Complete server lifecycle: create, configure, start, stop, restart, delete servers
  • 6-step server creation wizard with same server type support as desktop
  • Player management: view online players with ping, whitelist, operators, banned players/IPs with add/remove
  • Real-time console with ANSI color support, log level filtering, search, command history, copy/share
  • Performance charts: live CPU%, RAM usage, TPS history graphs with configurable time ranges
  • playit.gg tunnel integration — create public TCP tunnels for server access without port forwarding
  • RCON remote console support with authentication, command sending, response display
  • File management: worlds, plugins, mods, datapacks, backups — upload, download, delete, rename
  • Automatic JDK installation (Adoptium Temurin) with device-appropriate version selection
  • Device-aware RAM/GC configuration — automatically tunes -Xms/-Xmx and GC flags based on available memory
  • Battery optimization exemption request to keep servers running in background
  • Dark/Light theme support with system sync and manual override
  • APK size: ~15 MB (native/PortalHost.apk), package: com.portalhost.app, minSdk 24, targetSdk 36

Desktop v5.0.25

  • Custom WiX installer template (template.wxs) with branded UI, license agreement, and custom actions
  • Creates "Uninstall PortalHost.lnk" shortcut in Start Menu and self-locating Uninstall.bat in install folder
  • Uninstall.bat uses %~dp0 for self-location — works regardless of working directory
  • Update checker with GitHub API (authenticated) and HTML fallback scraping for private repo access
  • Release tag regex handles suffixes like -desktop, -mobile for multi-platform releases
  • GitHub token support stored in DataStore preferences — user enters PAT in Settings → Updates
  • Version parsing compares major.minor.patch numerically, ignores pre-release suffixes
  • Toast notifications for update available, download progress, install ready

Desktop v5.0.20 — Compose Multiplatform Migration

  • Full migration from Swing/JavaFX to Compose Multiplatform (Kotlin 1.9+, Compose 1.5+)
  • Kotlin Multiplatform project structure: commonMain (shared logic), desktopMain (JVM UI)
  • ServerManager with sanitized folder names (replaces invalid chars: \ / : * ? " < > | with _)
  • Preferences via Multiplatform Settings (DataStore on JVM) — JDK paths, GitHub token, theme, auto-update
  • Dashboard with server cards showing status badge, version, type, memory, port, quick actions
  • ProcessManager with ManagedProcess wrapper — stdout/stderr capture, PID tracking, graceful shutdown
  • ServerDownloader with PaperMC, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Purpur, Folia API integrations
  • JdkManager auto-detects installed JDKs, downloads missing versions from Adoptium API
  • SQLite database via SQLDelight for server configs, console logs, backup metadata, player data
  • Koin dependency injection for all services (ServerManager, ProcessManager, JdkManager, etc.)
